description: This file defines the API interface functions for the frontend of a bug tracking or project management system. It includes functions for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, DELETE, PATCH) to perform CRUD operations on work items, comments, and authentication-related actions, with error handling and authorization management.

methods.name: isPublicPath(path)
methods.description: Determines if a given API path is public (no authorization required) or protected.

methods.name: buildHeaders(path, extra = {})
methods.description: Builds HTTP headers, including Authorization if the path is protected.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse(resp, data, path)
methods.description: Handles error responses from fetch calls, manages auto-logout on 401, and throws appropriate errors.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to the backend API with authorization if required.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Performs a POST request with JSON payload and authorization.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Performs a GET request with optional query parameters and authorization.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Performs a PATCH request with JSON payload and authorization.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a comment to a work item, attempting to source the author ID from localStorage or parameters.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a list of work items, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item with optional attributes, including the creator name from localStorage.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Builds a full URL for a given API path based on the current base URL.
